title: Pinned published Chia puzzle, library, example, and host-source discovery

scope.claim: Complete suffix-selected regular tracked files in the recorded Git trees, not all published puzzles or deployed programs.
scope.classification_note: Path triage can group mixed modules or test data. A source-file count is not a count of distinct, valid, audited, deployed, or Rust-compilable puzzles.
limitations: Discovery is bounded to the seed list and the exact public repository-search queries/results in discovery.json; GitHub search indexing is not complete.
Private/deleted/unindexed repositories, other hosts, unpublished code, future commits, recursively linked repositories, and unrecorded forks are outside this snapshot.
Submodules and symlinks are listed but not followed. Embedded Markdown/Python/JSON/other-language programs and unrecognized suffixes are not source-file entries.
The existing tutorial-examples.json is a separate pinned page/span inventory; this catalog does not replace or complete it.
Git blob SHA1 fingerprints tracked file bytes (including hex text), not compiled CLVM bytes or CLVM tree hashes. Source SHA256 is not claimed without downloading source bytes.
Repository license metadata does not establish every file license or grant permission to copy or port. NOASSERTION means no SPDX classification was established.
Rust host builders, serialized-program bindings, VM/compiler implementations, negative fixtures, and generated data are not source compiled by this project.
Enumeration is not execution, interoperability, security review, module identity, cost compatibility, or a universal compiler-correctness proof.
